Here are 10 creative student project ideas involving a Python API and a web UI:

1. Movie Recommendation Engine
- Use TMDB or IMDB API
- Create a web UI where users can input preferences
- Backend generates personalized movie recommendations
- Features: genre filtering, rating-based suggestions

2. Language Translation Dashboard
- Integrate Google Translate or DeepL API
- Web interface supports multiple language translations
- Real-time translation with text-to-speech option
- Track translation history

3. Weather Forecast Visualization
- Use OpenWeatherMap API
- Interactive map showing global weather conditions
- Detailed forecast for selected locations
- Graphical representation of temperature trends

4. Cryptocurrency Price Tracker
- Utilize CoinGecko or CoinMarketCap API
- Real-time price updates and historical data
- Customizable alerts for price changes
- Portfolio tracking functionality

5. GitHub Profile Analytics
- Leverage GitHub API
- Visualize user's repository statistics
- Contribution graph and language breakdown
- Compare multiple GitHub profiles

6. Recipe Generator
- Use Spoonacular or Edamam API
- Input available ingredients
- Generate recipe suggestions
- Nutritional information and cooking instructions

7. Air Quality and Pollution Monitor
- Integrate AirVisual or OpenAQ API
- Interactive map showing pollution levels
- Health recommendations based on air quality
- Historical data visualization

8. Stock Market Dashboard
- Alpha Vantage or Yahoo Finance API
- Real-time stock price tracking
- Portfolio simulation
- Technical analysis charts

9. Travel Destination Explorer
- Skyscanner or Amadeus API
- Find flight and hotel recommendations
- Budget-based trip planning
- Interactive destination information

10. COVID-19 Global Tracker
- Use COVID-19 tracking APIs
- Global and country-specific statistics
- Graphical representation of case trends
- Vaccination progress visualization

Each project involves:
- Python backend API
- Web framework (Flask/Django)
- Frontend (HTML/CSS/JavaScript)
- API integration
- Data visualization
- Interactive user experience

Would you like me to elaborate on any of these project ideas?
